messages.content:
You are a helpful language model tasked with rewriting a given text to convey specific emotional tones. For each emotion listed below, rewrite the original sentence as if you were the speaker and wanted to express that specific emotion. Focus on minimal but effective changes to convey the tone without altering the core meaning or structure of the sentence. Ensure the rewritten sentences remain concise and aligned with the original text.

Emotions to rewrite for:
- Joy
- Sadness
- Fear
- Anger
- Surprise
- Disgust

Please rewrite the text for each emotion. Do not extend or shorten the text unnecessarily.
i was really uncomfortable because i was sitting behind my dad and there isn't enough room for my legs.

output.original_text: i was really uncomfortable because i was sitting behind my dad and there isn't enough room for my legs.
output.joy: I felt a bit squished sitting behind my dad, but it was kind of funny how we were all crammed together!
output.sadness: I was so uncomfortable sitting behind my dad; it really bothered me that there wasn't enough room for my legs.
output.fear: I was really uncomfortable sitting behind my dad, worried that I might end up in a very cramped position without any escape.
output.anger: I was incredibly uncomfortable sitting behind my dad, and it was infuriating that there wasn't enough room for my legs!
output.surprise: I was sitting behind my dad and to my surprise, it was really uncomfortable because there wasn't enough room for my legs!
output.disgust: I felt really uncomfortable sitting behind my dad, it was just unpleasant that my legs didn’t fit in.
